item.title: Niger State Lifts Partial Ban on Motorcycles and Tricycles
item.description: The Niger State Government has approved the complete lifting of restrictions on motorcycles and tricycles in Minna, allowing movement between 8:00 p.m. and 6:00 a.m. This decision ends a nine-month ban that was originally imposed on April 22, 2025, to curb criminal activities and enhance public safety.
